get.summary: Private read-only moderation case export with verified histories and offline checksum
get.description: Local operator bearer authorization and existing browser-origin admission required. Confidential reporter identities, claims and notes. One transactional D1 read batch; no provider calls or mutation. Complete retained case up to 10 reports, 20 hold reviews and 1 MiB; oversize fails without truncation. No authorship, allegation validity or deletion authority. Independently retain export_hash to detect replacement or omission.

200.description: Confidential no-store case export: v1 original histories; v2 adds authorship; v3 adds the submission's complete source-excerpt history plus authorship (possibly empty). New streams are component-hashed and counted. Standalone comparison artifacts capture other submissions separately. All three versions replay offline; no digital signature, authorship, originality or reward certification.

No source fetch, visibility change or report-hold release.
